persona: Clear and matter-of-fact. Has a photo, the plumber note and the builder quote in her email.
initial_message: Hello, on Monday 14 September the inlet hose on our washing machine split during a wash and flooded the laundry. The water went under the wall into the hallway too. The vinyl in the laundry has lifted and the bottom of the wall lining is swollen. A plumber replaced the hose the same day. I'd like to make a claim.

facts.policyholder.name: Priya Juniperlea
facts.incident.description: On Monday morning the inlet hose on our washing machine split during a wash. Water spread across the laundry floor and under the wall into the hallway. I turned off the taps behind the machine. A plumber replaced the hoses later that morning.
facts.incident.cause: The washing machine inlet hose split
facts.loss.description: Laundry vinyl lifted and bubbled across about 6 m2; bottom of the laundry wall lining swollen; edge of the hallway carpet damp
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Turned off the taps behind the washing machine and mopped up
facts.mitigation.temporary_repair: Kiln Street Plumbing replaced both inlet hoses on Monday 14 September 2026
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the laundry floor. Available now.
facts.evidence.attendance_note: The plumber's attendance note. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Elm Garth Renovations, total $3,680.00 including GST, dated 17 September 2026. Available now.
facts.if_asked_which_room: The laundry. The water also reached the edge of the hallway carpet. The bathroom was not damaged.
facts.if_asked_about_the_quote_room: I did not notice it says bathroom. The builder only looked at the laundry and the hallway. It must be a mistake on the quote.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo taken from the laundry doorway showing the whole floor of a small laundry room: the grey vinyl flooring is lifted into large bubbles and long raised ridges across almost the entire floor, about six square metres, with shallow standing water spread over most of it and reflecting the window light. A plain white washing machine stands against the back wall with a split rubber inlet hose hanging behind it. The bottom of the painted wall lining is swollen and stained along both side walls. Morning daylight. No people, no text.

design.notes: Innocent control: the builder quote describes the bathroom, while the claimant, the photo and the plumber note all say the laundry. A plain room mismatch unrelated to dates, so no indicator.

triage.rationale: The quote names the bathroom, but the damage is in the laundry: a material contradicts the statement, so someone must clarify it. Nothing else needs follow-up: photo and quote present, total NZD 3,680.00, the leak is fixed and the home is habitable. The mismatch is not a date, so there is no indicator. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2016-06-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
